name: chaotic
description: Negativity from a perception that your mind or the environment is unordered or out of control.
perceptions: Things are not following a pattern I recognize.
I can't predict what's going to happen.
I don't feel like I have any control over what's going to happen.
results: You may enjoy the stimulation for a while, but most people prefer some order in their lives.
examples: A playground full of young kids.
A crowded airport on a holiday weekend.

guidance.description: Various tips on dealing with a situation that seems chaotic.

variations.name: welcome chaos
variations.description: Positivity from a perception that your mind or the environment is unordered or out of control.
perceptions: I feel my environment has been stuck in an unpleasant way.
Things are not following a pattern I recognize.
I can't predict what's going to happen.
Maybe things will wind up better than they were.
results: You may enjoy the stimulation for a while, but most people prefer some order in their lives.
examples: Joining an energetic protest for something you feel strongly about.

commentaries.quote: Chaos was the law of nature; order was the dream of man.
In times of chaos, get back to who you are. Hold on to your inner light. Stay focused.
Chaos in the midst of chaos isn't funny, but chaos in the midst of order is.
We adore chaos because we love to produce order.
Chaos does not mean total disorder. Chaos means a multiplicity of possibilities.
